DealEvent.description: A line of the deal's journal (FR-4.7).
DealEvent.title: DealEvent

DealStatus.description:
Three states a deal moves through, and three it ends in. Its two transfers move on
their own while it is accepted, in any order (QUESTIONS H2, ADR-0024).
DealStatus.title: DealStatus

FixedRate.description: `rate_spec` v1 of type fixed: one quote per wanted currency (ADR-0004).
FixedRate.title: FixedRate

Invite.description: An outstanding invite. Its link can't be shown again: only a hash is kept.
Invite.title: Invite

MarketQuote.description: 1 `base` = `value` `quote` on the market, rounded the way people type a rate.
MarketQuote.title: MarketQuote

OrderDraft.description: What the wizard publishes (FR-2.1). A value from a form, checked here for its rules.
OrderDraft.title: OrderDraft

PaymentKind.description:
How money moves, one set for both sides (ADR-0016): an order's payout methods, and
a deal's legs. Three, as the owner put it: «нал, банк или крипта» (QUESTIONS G3,
ADR-0021). A card or a phone transfer is «bank».
PaymentKind.title: PaymentKind

Proposal.description: What the proposal form sends (FR-4.1). Amounts are in the order's own currency.
Proposal.title: Proposal

Quote.description: 1 `base` = `value` `quote`, in the direction the author typed it: «1 GEL = 29,20 RUB».
Quote.title: Quote

QuoteRate.description: «1 base = value quote»: the rate the amount came from, to show beside it.
QuoteRate.title: QuoteRate

Rate.description:
«1 base = value quote», as the order's author typed it or the market had it, locked
at the proposal.
Rate.title: Rate

ReferenceRate.description:
`rate_spec` v1 of type reference: the market's rate whenever someone looks, and the
rate of the moment once a proposal locks it (QUESTIONS G2, ADR-0022). Coinbase is the
one source so far (ADR-0020). A markup can join it later with a default.
ReferenceRate.title: ReferenceRate

Visibility.description: Who may see an order. Its author alone is told.
Visibility.title: Visibility

Want.description: A currency the author would take, where, and at what rate (ADR-0026).
Want.title: Want

get.description: What orders may give and want (FR-2.2). Config, so the app asks rather than knows.
Your deals: open ones, closed ones, or all; on one order, if you name it.

delete.description:
Delete your own finished deal, for yourself alone (QUESTIONS J3). The other side keeps
it, and it is erased once its order's author has deleted the order too.

post.description: Accept a proposal on your order: one tap, no payment details (QUESTIONS G1).
Before the first «Отправлено», either side cancels alone (FR-4.5).
After the first «Отправлено», ask the other side to cancel (FR-4.5).
«Проблема», with a word on what went wrong (FR-4.6).
Propose how a dispute ended; the same outcome from the other side settles it.
Ask someone to link by their @username. When they had already asked, it links.

delete.description: Break an active link, or withdraw one's own pending request.

get.description:
«Открытые мне» (`visible`), «Мои» (`mine`, the open ones) or the finished ones that
are mine or that I had a deal on (`history`). `within` narrows «Открытые мне» to
authors at most so many handshakes away (QUESTIONS J2).

delete.description:
Delete a finished order with all its deals, for yourself alone (QUESTIONS J3). Whoever
dealt on it keeps their deals and the order with them.

post.description: Propose a deal on an order open to you (FR-4.1), at its rate of this moment.
A closed order, open again as it was (QUESTIONS F7).

What `amount` of the give currency comes to in the want currency, at the order's
rate: the author's, or the market's of the moment (QUESTIONS G2).

get.description: The market's rate, which the wizard fills in for the author to keep or change (F5).
